Acme SRE (customer): Hey team — our free-trial org org_acme_42 ran ~12k tokens yesterday but the dashboard wallet stayed at 1000 credits. API returns 200 and generated content is correct. Happens after the client reconnects mid-stream. Can we debug? :frowning:

Maya (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste one example request_id + approximate timestamps? also which SDK (node/python) and whether you used streaming WS or SSE?

Acme SRE (customer): Using our Node WS client v0.9.2. Example: request_id=req_8f7a9c, session_id=sess_11, time ~2026-02-28T14:12:03Z. Flow: start stream -> client sees partial -> reconnects -> resumes -> final chunk delivered. UI shows generated text. No debit.

Maya (Support): Thanks. @Jens / @Priya tagging billing/infra for ledger trace. Can you check ledger entries for org_acme_42 around that time?

ledger-bot: ledger-query: org=org_acme_42 AND time>=2026-02-28T14:10:00Z AND time<=2026-02-28T14:20:00Z -> 2 events: session_start(sess_11), finalize_missing OR finalize recorded with zero delta. (look like finalize was received but debit delta = 0)

Jens (Billing Eng): Hmm. Did the client maybe call finalize twice with different idempotency keys? We dedupe by finalize_id currently. If resume creates a new finalize id but we already applied a deferred debit, weirdness can happen. Do you have raw client logs showing finalize payloads?

Acme SRE (customer): I pulled logs. Two finalize calls within 1s:
```
POST /v1/sessions/sess_11/finalize
body: {"finalize_id":"fin_1","tokens":12034}
HTTP 200

POST /v1/sessions/sess_11/finalize
body: {"finalize_id":"fin_2","tokens":12034}
HTTP 200
```
We assumed server should deduct once. Both returned 200. Wallet unchanged.

Priya (SRE): Interesting. If both returned 200 but wallet didn't change, possibilities: (1) finalize accepted but debit job failed later and retried without updating ledger, (2) finalize suppressed by downstream anti-dup and credit delta computed as 0, or (3) race between finalize and a concurrent restore/billing reconciliation job that reset balance. Will run repro locally.

Jens (Billing Eng): On the ledger side we mark drafts and then apply commit. I see a commit attempt at 14:12:04 but commit response from payments subsystem returned 409 conflict and we retried, eventually marking delta=0 to avoid double-charge after a reconciliation edge-case. That 409 handling seems too forgiving.

Maya (Support): Action items: collect full HTTP traces (headers + idempotency keys), confirm whether finalize_id was unique per logical session, and share a short repro script that simulates reconnect/resume.

Acme SRE (customer): Here's a small repro script we ran locally (Node pseudo):
```
// open ws, send chunks, simulate reconnect -> send finalize twice
const sendFinalize = (id) => fetch(`/v1/sessions/${sess}/finalize`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ finalize_id: id, tokens: 12034 }) })
await sendFinalize('fin_1')
await sendFinalize('fin_2')
```
Both return 200.

Priya (SRE): Reproduced locally using their pattern. When finalize calls happen within ~500ms and the payments gateway returns transient 409 on the first commit, our retry logic marks the ledger row as "applied_with_conflict" and sets delta=0 to avoid partial double-charge. That explains zero debit showing. Not ideal.

Jens (Billing Eng): Proposed quick fix: change commit retry path to preserve tentative delta and re-queue the job for human review on repeated 409s rather than collapsing to delta=0. Longer term: make finalize idempotent by both finalize_id and job_uuid computed from session+client_nonce and ensure compare-and-swap on the ledger uses (org, session, finalize_id) as key.

Maya (Support): For the customer we can offer two mitigations: (A) manual ledger correction crediting the 12k tokens back while we patch, or (B) ask them to update client to send a stable finalize_id derived from session (so retries are true retries). Which do you prefer?

Acme SRE (customer): We prefer the manual credit for now plus a short-lived mitigation — we'll change client to persist finalize_id.

Jens (Billing Eng): I'll open billing infra ticket BLG-3291 to implement the commit retry fix and idempotency improvements. ETA: patch and deploy in 48-72h.

Priya (SRE): I'll also add a monitoring alert for finalize->commit 409s and count orgs affected, so we catch regressions.

Maya (Support): Thanks — I'll proceed with a manual credit for org_acme_42 for 12034 token-equivalent free-trial units and confirm once done.

ledger-bot: manual-credit: org_acme_42 amount=12034 reason="support: missed finalize debit" by=Maya (Support) -> SUCCESS 2026-02-28T18:03:12Z

Acme SRE (customer): Confirmed wallet updated, thanks all. Will update client finalize_id persistence this week. :tada:

Maya (Support): Closing loop: credits restored, BLG-3291 created, monitoring alert added. Re-open if you see more. :thumbsup:
